editorialDescription: Draft — write original analysis from the brand's official specifications before publishing.
researchNotes: Reviewed 2026-10-12: DermRays 810nm diode laser (not IPL), sold by Dermrays. Not published: the listing doesn't name its model, so it can't be tied to a clearance. DermRays' 810nm V4S/V8S models are cleared under K230090 (Wuhan Lotuxs, 2023-04-19, OTC, 'permanent reduction in hair regrowth' as FDA defines it). The listing also says 'SAFE & PAINLESS' and 'No need for goggles', which are unsafe to repeat for a laser. Consider the brand's named V4S listing instead (B0D41BR1V2) after checking it. Previous note: From a sponsored Amazon result claiming 'permanent reduction'. Check for an FDA 510(k) record, skin-tone and hair-color suitability, and eye-safety warnings; don't repeat permanence claims. Imported from spreadsheet row 4.
